evidence: The IGZO thin films were deposited by PEALD using (3-dimethylamino)propyl)dimethyl indium (DADI) as the indium precursor, diethylzinc (DEZ) as the zinc precursor, trimethylgallium (TMGa) as the gallium precursor, and O2 plasma as the reactant on a Si(100) substrate with a native oxide layer after acetone washing.
